description: Red team exercises simulating adversary tactics are not conducted. This signal indicates that the organization's defense capabilities against realistic attacks are not validated.
applicability: Applicable to Level 3 environments requiring adversary simulation. Includes red team exercises, purple team activities, and adversary emulation.

metadata.detection_notes: Detected through red team program review, exercise history verification, and defensive improvement tracking.

sources.title: NIST SP 800-171 Rev 2 - System and Communications Protection
32 CFR Part 170 - Cybersecurity Maturity Model Certification Program
